race.comment: FEARLESS WRITER (5) gets the nod after missing by a long neck at this track last start, and the return of Damian Lane strengthens a profile already rated highly on recent form. The Ballarat run prior in a BM66 had genuine interference, so she has the right grounding for this. Looks the one to beat. ROUGH ENUFF (1) is the progressive danger, having won a Mdn at Sale as favourite after closing strongly second-up, and he has already won around 1500m. Has come back a better horse this campaign and he can continue to work through the grades. DIAMANDA (6) was plain here last time, but her Open win at Cranbourne the run before and strong track-and-trip résumé keep her firmly in play. Can bounce back. TWO TO TANGO (4) comes off a solid BM62 fourth at Swan Hill, gains an apprentice claim and is fitter third-up. SO YOU EXCEL (10) is better than she showed last start and can bounce back with the blinkers being reapplied.
